rules.label: Placement and prominence of declarations
rules.legal_reference: Rule 9 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (declarations must appear on the principal display panel, grouped and prominent)
rules.legal_reference_hi: विधिक माप विज्ञान (पैकबंद वस्तु) नियम, 2011 का नियम 9 (मुख्य प्रदर्शन पटल पर घोषणाएं)
rules.note: AI-assessed relative judgment of whether declarations are grouped together and prominently displayed, not a definitive legal determination of principal display panel compliance.

rules.label: No misleading, conflicting, or improperly altered declarations
rules.label_hi: कोई भ्रामक, परस्पर विरोधी या अनुचित रूप से परिवर्तित घोषणा नहीं
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(3) and Rule 18 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (prohibition on altering, obliterating, or improperly stickering declarations, particularly the retail sale price)
rules.legal_reference_hi: विधिक माप विज्ञान (पैकबंद वस्तु) नियम, 2011 का नियम 6(3) एवं नियम 18 (घोषणाओं विशेषतः खुदरा मूल्य में परिवर्तन/मिटाना निषिद्ध)
rules.note: AI-assessed check for visible signs of tampering: conflicting values for the same declaration (e.g. two different MRPs), stickers covering the original declaration, mismatched print/font suggesting alteration. Not a definitive forensic determination.

notes.penalty_reference: Non-compliance is punishable under Section 36(1) of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
notes.penalty_reference_hi: अननुपालन विधिक माप विज्ञान अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 36(1) के तहत दंडनीय है।
